item: The diagnostics set is built beside the old one with a room check, the build hands its read connection back between members, a killed run's journal is carried, and a member's error text is scrubbed of the passphrase where it is made
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py src/api/diagnostics_volumes.py src/monitoring/exit_evidence.py src/monitoring/forensics.py src/monitoring/session_hwm.py tests/test_diagnostics_volumes.py tests/test_all_diag_read_release.py tests/test_member_error_scrub.py tests/test_exit_evidence.py
summary: The numbered set is built in a folder beside the live one and swapped in whole, after a room check that keeps the 512 MiB floor and drops the drive's one per cent, so a failed split leaves the previous set serving; a refusal says the earlier set was untouched only when one was there, and a quota error or a drive that fills halfway is a 507; files a killed publish left are swept for whichever sidecar loads. The build hands its pooled read connection back at every member boundary and the manifest's run.read_release counts released, nothing-to-release and declined, so the checkpoint record no longer names the build as the oldest reader for its whole run. A run that died leaves its journal and the next bundle carries it marked previous_run; each gated member records what the gate read; rss_peak_rise_kb is absent with a reason when the high-water mark did not move; the lifetime marks carry the time they were set and RSS and swapped-out pages are shown apart. A member's error text is scrubbed of the passphrase the process holds, on the whole text before the cut to 300 characters, and withheld when the scrub cannot run
